title: Introduction and evaluation of a post-resuscitation conversation in the intensive care unit
summary: Healthcare professionals in hospitals experience resuscitations as part of their professional work. These can be perceived as mentally stressful and lead to long-term effects such as post-traumatic stress disorder. In order to deal with emergency situations, the European Resuscitation Council recommends the implementation of structured interprofessional debriefings. Based on the data situation and requests from employees, a project to introduce a post-resuscitation discussion in the cardiology intensive care unit at the Heart and Diabetes Center NRW, University Hospital of the Ruhr University Bochum; Medical Faculty OWL (Bielefeld University) (HDZ NRW) was therefore implemented in 2021 with positive results. For this reason, the project is to be extended to other intensive care units in the HDZ NRW and evaluated in parallel.
conditions: Effects of post-resuscitation discussions on the interdisciplinary team.

interventions.name: Implementation of a post-resuscitation talk by using a debriefing protocol on a total of three intensive care units. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Informed and voluntary participation of nurses of physicians, fixed location on the duty roster and practical deployment on the participating intensive care unit.
Exclusion criteria:
Further medical staff, no placement on the duty roster and no practical assignment in the participating intensive care unit.
